Donate

Help keep needlework thriving

The Needlework Guild of Minnesota is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, so your gift is tax-deductible as allowed by law. Donations fund our programs and guest instructors, sustain the members’ library, and support community outreach — all while keeping dues low so anyone can join.

Give

Make your gift

Use the secure donation form just below to give by card — a one-time gift or a recurring monthly donation. Every amount makes a difference.

Alternatives

Prefer to give another way?

Send a check, give monthly, or dedicate a gift in someone’s honor. Questions, or want to give another way? Get in touch.

By mail

Prefer a check? Make it out to the Needlework Guild of Minnesota and mail it to our PO Box — the mailing address is in the footer below.

Give monthly

Set up a recurring monthly gift in the form above to support the Guild all year long.

In honor or memory

Dedicate a gift to a stitcher you love — note the honoree with your donation and we’ll record the dedication.

Join

Find your people
and your stitching

We’d love to have you. Come sit in on a Stitch-In, or any of our other monthly meetings — in person or on Zoom, whichever fits your calendar. Try as many as you’re curious about. Once you’ve found the one (or three) that feel like yours, join us for just $30 a year.
